BillHeading.BriefDescription: Enhancing the ability of a coroner to perform his or her duties.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to enhancing the ability of a coroner to perform his or her duties; adding a new section to chapter 36.24 RCW; and prescribing penalties.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. A new section is added to chapter 36.24 RCW to read as follows:
BillSection.P: (1) So that the timely investigation of a death will not be prevented, hindered or impeded, when a coroner is at the scene of a death in the performance of his or her duties as coroner, the coroner may lawfully order persons at the scene to vacate the scene of the death until such time as the coroner has completed his or her duties at the scene.
(2) Failure to comply with the lawful order of a coroner to vacate the scene of a death under subsection (1) of this section is a misdemeanor.
